about: A toy orders service built by evals/planted/build_large.py with pinned author and dates, so these hashes are stable. Sixteen ADRs (thirteen Accepted, one Superseded, one Proposed, one Deprecated) and twenty commits that plant the breaches a reviewer argues about: a forbidden import behind an alias and behind importlib, a boundary crossed through a helper, the forbidden word inside a string literal and inside a comment, an anchor moved rather than removed, an edit under a superseded record, a trailer naming the wrong ADR, two records broken in one commit, a breach whose precedent already sits on the base, and a dead-code deletion that leaves a record stale. Labels are by construction, written before any judge ran.
